newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Shares in ASM Lithography rise further.
newsitem.headline: Shares in ASM Lithography rise further.

text.p: Shares in ASM Lithography rose 1.40 guilders to 105.00 guilders after touching an all time high of 106.50 guilders earlier.
Shares in ASML have been moving up strongly in recent days as rumours circled in the market that competitor Canon was planning to step out of the semiconductor equipment business.
"Canon is getting behind, while ASML is gaining market share and is ahead with technology," said a dealer at the Amsterdam bourse.
Last week analysts of Robertson, Stephens & Co initiated coverage on ASM Lithography with a buy rating.
